ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the upper part of the figure is Figure A, and the lower part is Figure B. Figure B has a total of four urban planning schematic diagrams, ①②③④; the dashed circle indicates the outer edge of the city, and the position of the circle center indicates the city center. In diagram ①, the black dots in the legend are “bus stations”; multiple bus station black dots are concentrated inside the circle, near the central urban area at the circle center. Diagram ② shows roads and a railway station close to the outer edge of the city and the position of transportation lines. Diagram ③ shows an expressway passing near the outer edge of the city, and the black dots of the commercial district have a certain connection with the road. Diagram ④ shows a road system composed of a ring road and radial roads. Then reason: according to the principles of urban transportation planning, bus stations belong to external transportation facilities and should be arranged at the outer edge of the city and close to external transportation trunk lines, so as to facilitate external connections while avoiding large passenger flows and vehicles entering the city center and aggravating traffic pressure in the central area. Scheme ① arranges the bus stations concentrated near the city center, which does not conform to this principle; therefore, the unreasonable planning scheme in Figure B is number ①.

method.method_draft: 按图例和圆心位置逐项检查规划是否符合城市交通布局原则。第②种火车站靠城市边缘且与道路相连，较合理；第③种高速公路绕开中心区并带动外围商业点，较合理；第④种环行路加道路联系有利于分散交通，较合理。相比之下，第①种把多个汽车站放在市中心附近，会造成中心区拥堵，因而是不合理方案，答案为1。
